none.$description: Table cells, full-bleed panes, anything that butts against another edge.

xs.$description: Status chips (scaled, not pills), tags, keyboard-key hints.

sm.$description: Checkboxes, small inline controls, items inside menus and lists.

md.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, the combobox, segmented controls: the control radius from the direction.

lg.$description: Panels, tables, cards, banners on the page.

xl.$description: The featured surface and floating layers (menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs): the largest level.

full.$description: Status dots and avatars only. Never buttons or chips.

control.$description: Primary buttons only: a slight lift so the main action feels pressable. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).

raised.$description: Panels and tables on the page: the direction separates panels by shadow. Soft, two layers. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).

featured.$description: The featured surface (the job that needs action): lifts much further than a panel. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).

overlay.$description: Floating layers: menus, popovers, comboboxes, tooltips, toasts, dialogs (dialogs add the scrim). The 1px layer gives the edge on white without a border. One light source from above; color neutral 950 (#111014) at low opacity. Values from the approved composition (specimen tool).
